title: TOPO-Loss for continuity-preserving crack detection using deep learning
mechanism: Connectivity-oriented loss (adapted from road delineation) designed to encourage crack continuity and to accommodate imprecise annotations, combined with MSE and Dice.
adaptation: Crack class on U-Net++, as an extra term with low weight. It is the only crack-domain topology loss with code and an imprecise-label design.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + TOPO term (crack), 3 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metric: component recall, crack IoU. Kill if crack IoU < baseline - 0.012.
evidence: R: improved topology on masonry crack sets. R (TopoMortar): TOPO unstable (CREMI Dice 0.63 +- 0.22) and over-segments OOD images.

alt_notes.adaptation: Only crack-domain topology loss with imprecise labels; reference only given its instability.
alt_notes.min_experiment: None planned; include only if the benchmark suite wants a crack-specific topology loss.
